wages.text: Fitzpatrick introduced the Fair Wage Act to raise the minimum wage indexed to local cost of living, voted for the Raise the Wage Act, and cosponsored the union-strengthening PRO Act.
wages.quote: every American deserves the dignity of fair pay for a hard day's work

trade.text: Fitzpatrick opposes broad tariffs and voted against and welcomed the striking down of blanket tariffs that raise consumer costs.
trade.quote: oppose any broad tariffs that raise costs on the American consumer

debt.text: Fitzpatrick says he is committed to protecting Social Security and Medicare benefits and will fight to protect and strengthen the programs.
debt.quote: it's your money, and I am absolutely committed to protecting the benefits you earned

safety.text: Fitzpatrick introduced legislation to fully fund police and penalize cities that defund them, opposing the defund movement.
safety.quote: I introduced the Defund Cities that Defund Our Police Act to make sure that our hero police officers are well-funded, not defunded

immigration.text: Fitzpatrick calls for a compromise that both tightens border security and protects Dreamers, backing each together rather than one alone.
immigration.quote: We must find the compromise that both secures our borders and protects our Dreamers

guns.text: Fitzpatrick cosponsored and voted for universal background-check legislation and other gun-safety bills.
guns.quote: We shouldn't have to wait for tragedies to happen to respond

abortion.text: He supports Pennsylvania's law allowing abortion up to 24 weeks but has also voted for some federal abortion restrictions.
abortion.quote: Fitzpatrick has said he supports Pennsylvania's current law permitting abortion up to 24 weeks and in cases after that when the mother's life and health are in danger.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act to bar transgender girls from female school sports.
gender.quote: Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick (R-Bucks) voted with the GOP majority in favor of women-only sports competitions.

cannabis.text: Fitzpatrick opposes recreational marijuana legalization, citing his law-enforcement experience, and voted against federal legalization bills.
cannabis.quote: I'm not a fan of recreational use and that is based on my experience

health.text: Fitzpatrick voted against ACA repeal and filed a discharge petition to extend Affordable Care Act premium subsidies.
health.quote: millions of Americans will be hit with premium increases they simply cannot afford

energy.text: Fitzpatrick says Congress must do more to combat climate change and backed carbon-fee legislation, arguing clean energy and growth are compatible.
energy.quote: We don't need to choose between clean energy and economic growth, or between combating climate change and creating jobs

voting.text: Fitzpatrick proposed federal photo-ID and signature-match requirements and voted against the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.
voting.quote: creating a consistent photo identification requirement for voting in federal elections
